subject: infra.connect
name: National 5G strategy
what_would_settle_it: A digital economy ministry or regulator strategy document; the regional regulators' association positively records that none is published, so this may close as a stated absence

subject: infra.connect
name: National fibre backbone and terrestrial transmission network
what_would_settle_it: A regulator or ministry network map or annual report giving route-kilometres and the backbone operator, or the digital acceleration project's procurement documents naming the fibre lots

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet exchange point
what_would_settle_it: A national exchange point's peering statistics, an Internet Society or registry statement, or a regulator register of interconnection points; the base names exchange points in Chad, Gabon and elsewhere and none in Togo

subject: infra.connect
name: Mobile network population coverage
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's annual market observatory or quarterly statistical bulletin, the equivalent of the series the base already holds in full for Nigeria

subject: infra.connect
name: Quality-of-service assessment results
what_would_settle_it: A published regulator assessment campaign report or a compliance decision against either operator; a regional guideline records that the Togolese survey instrument exists

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet shutdown or throttling in 2025
what_would_settle_it: A network-measurement or shutdown-tracker country entry with dates and duration; the continental table the base holds names the event in two words

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Constituting instrument of the cybersecurity agency
what_would_settle_it: The cybersecurity and cybercrime amending law of June 2022; the agency's creation date currently rests on a one-line paraphrase in a World Bank implementation report

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Incident response team operational record
what_would_settle_it: An incident-response profile of the kind the base holds for Rwanda and Ghana, an annual incident report, or a membership record with an international response network; the 333,000-incident total is a single news attribution with no breakdown

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Terms of the joint venture running the national incident response team
what_would_settle_it: The government-supplier joint-venture agreement or shareholding record; the base establishes that a foreign-partnered company runs the national response function and nothing about the terms, the data-handling arrangements or the duration

subject: infra.store
name: Lome Data Centre capacity and utilisation
what_would_settle_it: The state operator's own statement or annual report, or the facility's tier certification record; the only market-level document the base holds is a commercial briefing whose figures are cited and deliberately not absorbed

subject: infra.energy
name: Power supply to the digital estate
what_would_settle_it: A utility or regulator connection record for the Lome Data Centre, or a rural electrification programme document covering base stations; no source in the base connects Togo's grid, tariffs or generation to any digital infrastructure

subject: dpi.id
name: Data-protection authority's authorisation for biometric and identification-number processing
what_would_settle_it: The authority's published register of authorisations, or the authorisation decision itself for the identity agency's processing; article 8 of the 2019 statute requires prior authorisation both for biometric data and for use of a national identification number, and the authority's own organisational decree is also unheld

subject: dpi.id
name: National citizen account or single sign-on
what_would_settle_it: Technical or service documentation for the public-services portal, or any statement on which agency systems federate to the identification number; the volunteering agency's new mobile application is the immediate test case

subject: dpi.exchange
name: National interoperability and data-exchange layer
what_would_settle_it: A digital agency or ministry statement naming Togo's government service bus, or a deployment report on the software licensed in June 2024, which is the only named candidate and has never been reported deployed

subject: dpi.mis
name: National health management information system
what_would_settle_it: A health ministry implementation record or annual health-statistics yearbook establishing whether a national health system exists alongside the education one; the only datapoint is a private supplier founded in 2025 with no client count, financing or deployment figure

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural connectivity or universal-service programme
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's annual report or the instrument establishing a universal-service fund, plus the published text of the July 2026 royalty amendment; the fund is named only as the recipient of 30 per cent of fine proceeds in a fee decree

subject: data.statistics
name: National open-data portal or statistical dissemination platform
what_would_settle_it: The national statistics institute's publication catalogue or a national data portal; the census dissemination is the obvious anchor document

subject: data.satellite
name: National satellite or earth-observation capability
what_would_settle_it: A national space agency or geospatial strategy instrument; the base's only Togo-facing space material is coverage of a Lome forum whose closing declaration was never issued

subject: dpi.registry
name: National social registry
what_would_settle_it: A social action ministry instrument creating a unified social register, or the appraisal document of a social-protection operation; the base establishes Togo had none before the pandemic and nothing since

subject: dpi.pay
name: Current status of the pandemic-era cash-transfer scheme
what_would_settle_it: A programme statement or evaluation dated after the 2023 case study; the base carries the 2020 scheme and its published figures and never says whether it still runs

subject: gov.protect
name: Decree fixing the data-protection authority's organisation and functioning
what_would_settle_it: The implementing decree the 2019 statute defers to regulation, published in the official journal; the decrees in the same gazette issue as the statute concern unrelated matters

subject: gov.policy
name: National artificial-intelligence strategy
what_would_settle_it: The strategy document, or the Council of Ministers communique or ministerial statement adopting it; a July 2026 report refers to a national strategy engaged by the government and the base holds no instrument, date, scope or budget

subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal or policy
what_would_settle_it: A national data portal, an open-data policy or decree, or a dataset catalogue; the base carries one Togolese source on this subject and it is an artificial-intelligence language-corpus project, not an open-data instrument

subject: gov.legislate
name: Access-to-information statute
what_would_settle_it: The gazetted statute, or a dated statement that no such law exists

subject: gov.legislate
name: Founding instrument creating the identity agency
what_would_settle_it: The gazetted law of September 2020 with its number and date; it is currently a one-line paraphrase in a World Bank implementation report

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybersecurity and cybercrime statute and its 2022 amendments
what_would_settle_it: The gazetted base law and the amending act that created the cybersecurity agency

subject: gov.legislate
name: Text of the spectrum-royalty amendment
what_would_settle_it: The gazetted decree with its number and the amended rate table; the regulator's site carries no 2026 royalties text and the rates reach the wiki only through a Council of Ministers communique

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Declaration issued at the Lome space forum
what_would_settle_it: The declaration text as issued at the close of the forum on 31 July 2026, or its publication by the organisers or the regulator

subject: tech.innovate
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Start-up statute or legal framework
what_would_settle_it: A law or decree on start-up labelling and incentives, or a ministerial statement that none exists; the industry association's own remedy for legal uncertainty was a private law-firm partnership

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: The data-collection start-up named as the flagship project's partner
what_would_settle_it: A company filing, an agency or association member listing, or a founder profile establishing founding date, size and funding

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Digital sector share of gross domestic product
what_would_settle_it: A national accounts series or ministry statistical annex; the base holds a government figure of about 4 per cent for 2022 against a stated target of 10 per cent, relayed by trade press with no target date and nothing measured since

subject: geopol.china
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Chinese digital or technology cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: Any memorandum, credit line or supplier contract naming Togo; the subject returns no Togolese source, and a full-text sweep of the base for the major Chinese vendors returns nothing tagged to Togo

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf-state digital or technology cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: Any investment, data-centre agreement or sovereign-fund commitment naming Togo; the subject returns no Togolese source at all

subject: geopol.india
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Indian digital or technology cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: Any memorandum, credit line, training-programme participation or supplier contract naming Togo; the subject returns no Togolese source

subject: include.divides
name: Universal service fund
what_would_settle_it: The fund's constituting instrument and any published annual report or regulator accounts showing its balance, governance body and disbursements; the only held reference is the article of the fee decree allocating 30 per cent of fine proceeds to it

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital-skills or digital-literacy programme
what_would_settle_it: A named national programme document with a target and timetable, or the digital-skills component workplan of the digital acceleration project or the European support programme, either of which would give the skills spend a named object rather than a budget line

subject: finance.budget
name: Domestic state appropriation to digital technology
what_would_settle_it: The finance law for 2026 or the finance ministry's budget annexes showing the appropriation to the digital ministry and the identity, cybersecurity, regulatory and digital agencies; the compiled budget outputs hold no Togo file

subject: include.divides
name: Gender-disaggregated digital access measure
what_would_settle_it: A sex-disaggregated figure from an international telecommunications or financial-inclusion series, or the national statistics institute's own household survey; the only gender figure in the section is a 2020 programme statistic carried by a 2023 reference study

subject: include.divides
name: Rural and urban connectivity gap measure
what_would_settle_it: A regulator coverage or penetration series broken down by region or by rural and urban area; the base holds only a sub-Saharan regional figure and Togo's rural population share
